dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Fragrance is no mere scent. It is a lifestyle. It is what we leave behind in living's wake.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Do you think such aromas dissipate all too easily? I will not deny that.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: But why, then, do they find new life within our dreams?
